name: Ogre Zombie
languages: Understands Common and Giant but can't speak

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The oni regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The oni makes two Claw or Nightmare Ray attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Nightmare Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. 9 (2d6 + 2) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the oni's next turn.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.desc: The oni shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid or a Large Giant, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The oni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- **At Will:**
- **1/Day Each:** Charm Person, Darkness, Gaseous Form, Sleep

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: The oni casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

name: Otyugh
languages: Otyugh; telepathy 120 ft. (doesn't allow the receiving creature to respond telepathically)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The otyugh makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition. Whenever the Poisoned target finishes a Long Rest, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10) and doesn't return to normal until the Poisoned condition ends on the target. Success: The Poisoned condition ends.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two tentacles.

actions.name: Tentacle Slam
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature Grappled by the otyugh. Failure: 16 (3d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the otyugh's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The owl doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 1 Slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The owlbear makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Nimble Escape
actions.desc: The panther takes the Disengage or Hide action.

name: Pegasus
languages: Understands Celestial, Common, Elvish, And Sylvan but can't speak

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Radiant damage.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.desc: The spider can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane while on the Material Plane and vice versa.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the spider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spider makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target becomes Stable, and it has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. While Poisoned, the target also has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Ethereal Jaunt
actions.desc: The spider teleports from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or vice versa.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.desc: The piranha can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target doesn't have all its Hit Points), reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The pirate makes two Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Enthralling Panache.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Enthralling Panache
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the pirate's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The pirate makes three attacks, using Rapier or Pistol in any combination.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the pirate has Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of this turn.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 30/90 ft. 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Captain's Charm
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the pirate's next turn.

actions.name: Riposte
actions.desc: _Trigger:_ The pirate is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. _Response:_ The pirate adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. On a miss, the pirate makes one Rapier attack against the triggering creature if within range.
